title: Wardrobe and Equipment-Fit Compatibility Catalog

fit_classes.description: Standard body garment projection where the governed topology declares the required anchors.
Large-frame presentation projection; scale is renderer metadata and does not alter biology.
Small-frame presentation projection; scale is renderer metadata and does not alter biology.
Four-arm topology with explicit secondary-arm anchors.
Six-limb topology; exact limb allocation is taken from topology authority rather than inferred.
Requires explicit wing-root clearance or compatible cutout/mask data.
Requires explicit tail-root clearance or compatible cutout/mask data.
Headwear requires declared head anchors and must not force humanoid ear/horn assumptions.
Nested appendage projection such as Suula hand/claw structures; parent/child anchors remain explicit.
Aquatic presentation class; no locomotion or breathing mechanics are inferred.
Insectoid renderer fit class; segment and limb facts must come from upstream topology authority.
Plant renderer fit class; no botanical anatomy is invented beyond upstream profiles.
Composite presentation class for repeated/constituent bodies such as ManyToms.
Explicit unresolved fit class. No standard humanoid fallback is implied.

rules: Presentation wardrobe never creates or changes actual inventory ownership.
Actual-equipment visual projection reads equipment authority but never changes mechanics, equip state, slot state, or ownership.
Unsupported fit is reported as unsupported; assets may not be silently warped, clipped, dropped, or substituted.
Partial fit requires an explicit diagnostic and may identify missing anchors/masks without inventing them.
Unknown topology remains unknown and may not receive a default humanoid fit claim.
Renderer fit metadata is not Character truth.
Hidden or unauthorized equipment identity must be permission-filtered before visual projection.
Wing, tail, horn, nested-appendage, and multi-limb clearance must use explicit topology/anchor data.
CAPP-06 defines fit compatibility; CAPP-08 defines export/framing behavior and CAPP-05 consumes fit_class as presentation input.
